# HEM v0.8.6b2 - Live controller countdowns

Visible PID wait, startup, device readiness and minimum on/off timers now count down on the dashboard using the deadline supplied by Home Assistant. One browser clock updates the labels and pauses when they are out of view or the tab is hidden.

At the end of a PID rest window the label shows that evaluation is due. Device operation and reported feedback continue to come from the controller.
